item.title: LSU Shreveport hosts 161 students for Dual Enrollment Day
item.description: LSUS hosted 161 Caddo Parish high school students for Dual Enrollment Day, giving them a firsthand look at college life and helping them feel confident navigating a college environment.

item.title: Reward raised to $3,000 for tips on Shreveport teen's murder
item.description: Six months after 17-year-old Cameron Ballentine was fatally shot in Shreveport's Martin Luther King neighborhood, police are asking the public for help and have increased the reward to up to $3,000 for information that leads to an arrest.

item.title: Livingston Parish Sheriff's Office seeking public's help to identify found child
item.description: LIVINGSTON PARISH, La. (KTVE/KARD) -- The Livingston Parish Sheriff’s Office is asking for the public’s assistance after a young child was found on Suma Hill Road.
